BerniniConditioning.description: Conditioning node for Bernini in-context video/image conditioning. It can be used for the following tasks: t2v (text-to-video), v2v (video-to-video), rv2v (reference-guided video editing), r2v (reference-to-video), ads2v (insert image/video into video).Reference images injected as in-context tokens (r2v, rv2v) are encoded independently at their own native aspect ratio (long edge capped at ref_max_size)

ref_max_size.tooltip: Max size for the long edge of reference_video and reference_images. Resized with preserved aspect ratio and snapped to 16px.

reference_image.tooltip: Reference image injected as an in-context token (r2v, rv2v).

reference_video.tooltip: Video to insert into the source video (ads2v).

source_video.tooltip: Source video to edit or restyle (v2v, rv2v). Resized to width/height and trimmed to length.

BerniniConditioning.name: BerniniConditioning

CFGOverride.description: Override cfg to a fixed value over a [start, end] percent (sigma) range. With multiple overrides, the one nearest the sampler wins on overlap.
CFGOverride.name: CFGOverride

CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

CLIPTextEncode.name: CLIPTextEncode
output_tooltips: A conditioning containing the embedded text used to guide the diffusion model.

CheckpointLoaderSimple.description: Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.

ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

CheckpointLoaderSimple.name: CheckpointLoaderSimple
output_tooltips: The model used for denoising latents.
The CLIP model used for encoding text prompts.
The VAE model used for encoding and decoding images to and from latent space.

audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit for sRGB and 10-bit for HDR. Explicit 8-bit and 10-bit choices are independent of colorspace.

codec.tooltip: Optionally encode the video immediately. None keeps the images in tensor form; Auto uses H.264.

color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

images.tooltip: The images to create a video from.

DualCLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:
sdxl: clip-l, clip-g
sd3: clip-l, clip-g / clip-l, t5 / clip-g, t5

newbie: gemma-3-4b-it, jina clip v2

negative.tooltip: Negative conditioning run on the negative model. Leave unconnected for a text-free (image-only) unconditional pass.

model.tooltip: Model used for the positive (conditional) pass.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

height.tooltip: The height of the latent images in pixels.

width.tooltip: The width of the latent images in pixels.

video.tooltip: The video to extract components from.

KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

KSampler.name: KSampler

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model used for decoding the latent.

LTXVConcatAVLatent.description: Merge a video latent and an audio latent into a joint AV latent (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).
LTXVConcatAVLatent.name: LTXVConcatAVLatent

LTXVDualCFGGuider.description: Separate CFG scales for the video and audio modalities of a packed LTXV-AV latent.
LTXVDualCFGGuider.name: LTXVDualCFGGuider

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to get configuration from.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent audio samples in the batch.

img_compression.tooltip: Amount of compression to apply on image.

LTXVSeparateAVLatent.description: Split a joint AV latent into its video and audio latents (any AV model, e.g. LTXV or MiniMax H3).
LTXVSeparateAVLatent.name: LTXVSeparateAVLatent

LanPaint_ImageDecode.description: Decode an inpainted latent, resize to the original image's exact dimensions, and merge with the original inside the mask (replaces VAEDecode + MaskBlend).

blend_overlap.tooltip: Boundary blend width in pixels between the inpainted and original image (MaskBlend-style).

image.tooltip: The original image. When given, the decoded output is resized to its exact dimensions.

mask.tooltip: The inpainting mask (1 = take the inpainted pixels, 0 = keep the original).

LanPaint_ImageDecode.name: LanPaint_ImageDecode

LanPaint_ImageEncode.description: Encode an image and attach an inpainting mask to the latent (replaces VAEEncode + SetLatentNoiseMask).

mask.tooltip: Inpainting mask [H, W] (1 = regenerate, 0 = keep). Snapped to the latent size automatically.

image.tooltip: The image to encode (1 = regenerate region comes from the mask).

LanPaint_ImageEncode.name: LanPaint_ImageEncode

LanPaint_KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

Inpainting_mode.tooltip: Choose Image mode for photos or Video mode for video frames with temporal consistency

LanPaint_Info.tooltip: For more info, visit https://github.com/scraed/LanPaint. If you find it useful, please give a star ⭐️!

LanPaint_NumSteps.tooltip: The number of steps for the Langevin dynamics, representing the turns of thinking per step.

LanPaint_PromptMode.tooltip: Image First: emphasis image quality, Prompt First: emphasis prompt following

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

LoraLoaderModelOnly.description: This LoRAs loader is used to modify the diffusion model, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.
LoraLoaderModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderModelOnly

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, snapped up to the model's 17k+5 grid (124 = ~5s; trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested)

MiniMaxH3MotionContextTrim.description: Remove the leading pinned frames from a decoded H3 clip, trimming picture and sound by the same duration.

audio.tooltip: Decoded audio for the same clip. Trimmed by the matching duration so sound stays locked to picture. Leave unwired for silent clips.

fps.tooltip: Frame rate used to convert the trim into an audio duration. Must match what you feed Create Video.

match_tail.tooltip: Make the audio duration equal frames/fps exactly, trimming a long tail or padding a short one with silence. H3 rounds its audio grid to the nearest step, so each clip carries about 8ms too much or too little sound, which accumulates at every join in a chain.

MiniMaxH3MotionContextTrim.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContextTrim

OTUNetLoaderW8A8.description: Load and Quantize INT8 models with fast triton inference.

enable_convrot.tooltip: Enable ConvRot for better quantization. ~1.1x slower, but near-GGUF_Q8 quality.

lora_mode.tooltip: None bakes LoRA patches with normal rounding which is the default behavior. Stochastic bakes with stochastic INT8 rounding, which can occasionally be closer to the BF16+lora baseline. Dynamic applies LoRA at inference time, which is slow and only works for conventional lora.

model_type.tooltip: Only used for on the fly quantization, to filter sensitive layers.

on_the_fly_quantization.tooltip: Quantize a higher precision model to INT8. If the selected model is already INT8 keep unchecked.

weight_dtype.tooltip: INT8 compute dtype. Default follows the model dtype, but uses fp16 for RTX 20/T4 sm75 GPUs and fp32 for GTX 16/unknown sm75 GPUs. Manual values force that dtype.

OTUNetLoaderW8A8.name: OTUNetLoaderW8A8

PreviewAny.description: Preview any input value as text.
PreviewAny.name: PreviewAny

QwenImage21Cache.description: Allows setting the KV cache device and quantization, by default the model uses the auto -option. Quantization potentially speeds up edit workflows when memory starved

device.tooltip: auto uses spare VRAM, then RAM. cpu (RAM) is prefetched behind compute and costs little speed. off recomputes the prefix every step, which is slower but is the one way to rule the cache out.

dtype.tooltip: Storage precision. default is lossless. int8 halves the cache at about bf16 accuracy, int4 quarters it but roughly doubles the per-step error.

QwenImage21Cache.name: QwenImage21Cache

batch_size.tooltip: Number of interpolation tasks per GPU call. Higher values improve throughput but use more VRAM. Set to 1 for the most conservative behaviour.

torch_compile.tooltip: Compile the model with torch.compile() for 10-30% faster inference after the first (warm-up) run. Requires PyTorch 2.0+.

background.tooltip: Choose output type: Alpha (transparent) or Color (custom background color).

background_color.tooltip: Pick background color (supports alpha, use color picker).

invert_output.tooltip: Enable to invert both the image and mask output (useful for certain effects).

mask_blur.tooltip: Specify the amount of blur to apply to the mask edges (0 for no blur, higher values for more blur).

mask_offset.tooltip: Adjust the mask boundary (positive values expand the mask, negative values shrink it).

process_res.tooltip: Set the processing resolution (higher values require more VRAM and may increase processing time).

refine_foreground.tooltip: Use Fast Foreground Colour Estimation to optimize transparent background

sensitivity.tooltip: Adjust the strength of mask detection (higher values result in more aggressive detection).

image.tooltip: Input image to be processed for background removal.

model.tooltip: Select the background removal model to use (RMBG-2.0, INSPYRENET, BEN).

ReferenceLatent.description: This node sets the guiding latent for an edit model. If the model supports it you can chain multiple to set multiple reference images.
ReferenceLatent.name: ReferenceLatent

ResizeImageMaskNode.description: Resize an image or mask using various scaling methods.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from width while preserving aspect ratio.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from height while preserving aspect ratio.

multiplier.tooltip: Scale factor (e.g., 2.0 doubles size, 0.5 halves size).

longer_size.tooltip: The longer edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

shorter_size.tooltip: The shorter edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Height auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Width auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels (e.g., 1.0 ≈ 1024×1024). Aspect ratio is preserved.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

match.tooltip: Resize input to match the dimensions of this reference image or mask.

multiple.tooltip: Resize so width and height are divisible by this number. Useful for latent alignment (e.g., 8 or 64).

resize_type.tooltip: Select how to resize: by exact dimensions, scale factor, matching another image, etc.

scale_method.tooltip: Interpolation algorithm. 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling, 'nearest-exact' for pixel art.

ResizeImageMaskNode.name: ResizeImageMaskNode

negative_coords.tooltip: Negative point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

positive_coords.tooltip: Positive point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

individual_masks.tooltip: Output per-object masks instead of union

refine_iterations.tooltip: SAM decoder refinement passes (0=use raw detector masks)

conditioning.tooltip: Text conditioning for detecting new objects during tracking

initial_mask.tooltip: Mask(s) for the first frame to track (one per object)

detect_interval.tooltip: Run detection every N frames (1=every frame). Higher values save compute.

max_objects.tooltip: Max tracked objects. Initial masks count toward this limit. 0 uses the internal cap of 64.

ref_track_data.tooltip: SAM3 track of the reference image(s) (one identity per object, colored in batch order), or a plain MASK of the reference subject (rendered as a single identity).

driving_track_data.tooltip: SAM3 track of the driving pose video. Will be rendered into the pose_video_mask output.

object_indices.tooltip: Comma-separated list of person indices to include (e.g. '0,2,3'). Applied to both reference and pose video masks. Empty = all.

replacement_mode.tooltip: False = Animation Mode (pose_video_mask has black background, reference_image_mask has white background). True = Replacement Mode (pose_video_mask has white background, reference_image_mask has black background).

sort_by.tooltip: Order in which palette colors are assigned to the tracked objects (applied to both reference and pose video so each identity keeps the same color). Objects that appear in earlier frames always come first; within a frame, left_to_right = leftmost object (by centroid at first appearance) gets the first color, area = biggest object (by mask area at first appearance) gets the first color; none = keep SAM3's order.

SeedVR2PostProcessing.description: Align the generated image with the original resized image and apply color correction.

color_correction_method.tooltip: Method to match the generated image colors to the original image. lab: transfer color in CIELAB space, preserving detail (most faithful). wavelet: transfer low-frequency color, keeping upscaled high-frequency detail. adain: match per-channel mean/std (fastest, global tint). none: skip color transfer (geometry alignment only).

original_resized_images.tooltip: The original resized image before pre-processing, used as reference.

SeedVR2PostProcessing.name: SeedVR2PostProcessing

SeedVR2Preprocess.description: Pad a resized image for SeedVR2 model. Alpha channel is dropped. The node Post-Process SeedVR2 Output re-applies it from the original resized image.
SeedVR2Preprocess.name: SeedVR2Preprocess
output_tooltips: The padded image for VAE encoding.

generate_audio_codes.tooltip: Enable the LLM that generates audio codes. This can be slow but will increase the quality of the generated audio. Turn this off if you are giving the model an audio reference.

images.tooltip: Reference images, seen by the text encoder and spliced into the sequence as VAE latents.

resolution.tooltip: Reference images are resized to about resolution x resolution pixels, at multiples of 32, preserving aspect ratio. 0 keeps each reference at its own size, rounded to a multiple of 32.

VAEDecode.description: Decodes latent images back into pixel space images.

vae.tooltip: The VAE model used for decoding the latent.

VAEDecode.name: VAEDecode

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to overlap.

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to decode at a time.

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to encode at a time.

duration.tooltip: Duration in seconds, or 0 for unlimited duration

strict_duration.tooltip: If True, when the specified duration is not possible, an error will be raised.

clip_vision_output.tooltip: CLIP vision features for conditioning. Model is trained with stretch resize to aspect ratio.

pose_video.tooltip: Video used for pose conditioning. Will be downscaled to half the resolution of the main video.

pose_video_mask.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Colored per-identity SAM3 mask video at the same resolution as pose_video.

previous_frames.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Full decoded output of the previous chunk. Only the last previous_frame_count are used as the extension anchor.

reference_image.tooltip: Reference image. The first image is the primary reference (composite all identities onto it). SCAIL-2: extra batch images are used as additional views (back view, close-up, occluded background), each needing a matching reference_image_mask in that identity's color.

reference_image_mask.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Colored reference mask, batch matching reference_image (first = primary reference mask, rest = identity masks for the additional reference_image).

replacement_mode.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. False = Animation Mode (pose_video_mask should have black background). True = Replacement Mode (pose_video_mask should have white background).

pose_end.tooltip: End step of the pose conditioning.

pose_start.tooltip: Start step of the pose conditioning.

previous_frame_count.tooltip: Tail frames of previous_frames to anchor. SCAIL-2 trained at 5 (81-frame chunks, 76-frame step).

video_frame_offset.tooltip: Cumulative output frame this chunk begins at. Wire from the previous chunk's video_frame_offset output.

YuE2GenerateABC.description: Generates the ABC notation of a song from style and lyrics. Connect abc to YuE2 Generate Music node.

mode.tooltip: full: generates melody and chords; melody: generates melody only, recommended for covers.

penalty_window.tooltip: Number of recent ABC tokens used to penalize repetition.

YuE2GenerateABC.name: YuE2GenerateABC

YuE2GenerateMusic.description: Generates music tokens and acoustic conditioning from style, lyrics, and an ABC notation. Provide the generated seconds to the Empty YuE2 Latent Audio node. An empty ABC input ignores the selected mode.

cfg_scale.tooltip: Autoregressive guidance for style and lyrics. 1.0 disables CFG, matching the ABC workflow. Use 1.01 to match the original off-mode guidance.

abc.tooltip: Connect the ABC generator or supply an edited score. Leave empty to use off mode automatically.

max_duration.tooltip: Maximum duration in seconds. Automatically reduced for long prompts; generation can stop earlier.

mode.tooltip: full: generates melody and chords; melody: generates melody only, recommended for covers.

YuE2GenerateMusic.name: YuE2GenerateMusic
